t2.Precision Shot: ATK rises by 20% and ACC rises by 400.
t2.Eagle Eye: Increases all allies' DEF Penetration by 150 and ACC by 75. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 50 additional DEF Penetration and 25 additional ACC apply.
t2.Mortal Wound: Upon a Crit Hit, reduces enemy's Heal Rate by 50% and deals continuous P.DMG equal to 20% of ATK every sec for 10 sec. This effect will not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
t2.Opportune Strike: Crit Chance is increased by 150 and Crit DMG is increased by 30%.
t2.Concentration: Every 5 sec, increases own Crit DMG by 4%. This effect can be stacked up to max 25 times and is irremovable.

t2.Target Weakness: ATK rises by 20% and DEF Penetration rises by 200.
t2.Swift and Nimble: Per every sec, Dodge rate is increased by 100. This effect can be stacked up to max 5 times, and resets upon dodging an attack.
t2.Tactical Foresight: Dodge rate is increased by 200 and takes 10% reduced DMG.
t2.Opportune Strike: Crit Chance is increased by 150 and Crit DMG is increased by 30%.
t2.Vital Detection: Upon attack, causes the target to take 10% increased All DMG and have their ATK Spd reduced by 100 for 10 sec. This effect activates once every 3 sec.

t1.Monster Hunting: Increases DMG to Non-Hero enemies by 10% and takes 10% reduced DMG.

t2.Experienced Fighter: Attacked targets take 20% more DMG. Does not stack.
t2.Excellent Strategy: Increases CC ACC of all allies by 150. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 50 additional CC ACC applies.
t2.Battle Cry: Increases HP of all allies by 15%. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 5% additional HP applies.
t2.Shield of Protection: Increases All Block by 200 and CC Resist by 200.
t2.Swift Move: Increases ATK Spd by 200 and ACC by 400.

t2.Target Weakness: ATK rises by 20% and DEF Penetration rises by 200.
t2.Ready Cannons: Mana recovery per second rises by 62.5% per every enemy.
t2.Special Bullet: Attacked target loses 15% of ATK and 150 of Crit. Chance. Does not stack.
t2.Amplified Gunpowder: Increases Crit DMG of all allies by 30%. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 10% additional Crit DMG applies.

t2.Vengeful Curse: When hit by an enemy, attacker's DMG is reduced by 70% for 3 sec. This effect only activates once in 40 sec, and cannot be dispelled.
t2.Goddess Blessing: Increases Crit Chance of all allies by 150. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 50 additional Crit Chance applies.
t2.Inner Peace: Heals all allies by 1% every sec and increases CC Resist by 75. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 0.3% additional healing per sec and 25 additional CC Resist apply.
t2.Blessing of Mana: Mana recovery per second rises by 250%.
t2.Swiftness: Increases ATK Spd of all allies by 150. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 50 additional ATK Spd applies.

t2.Opportune Strike: Crit Chance is increased by 150 and Crit DMG is increased by 30%.
t2.Warlike: Increases ATK by 7% and CC Resist by 30 per enemy. This can be stacked up to max 10 times.
t2.Offensive Guard: ATK rises equal to half of P.DEF and received P.DMG decreases by 15%.
t2.Tactical Foresight: Dodge rate is increased by 200 and takes 10% reduced DMG.
t2.Blood Wrath: Increases Lifesteal by 200 and ATK Spd by 200.

t2.Deception: When receiving DMG, becomes immune to the next 3 hit of DMG. This effect is activated every 40 sec.
t2.Moral Rise: Increases ATK of all allies by 15%. If the ally uses the same Perk, only 3% additional ATK applies.
t2.Blessing of Mana: Mana recovery per second rises by 250%.
t2.Circuit Burst: Receives 15% more DMG but gains 40% ATK. ACC is increased by 200.
t2.Destruction: Increases Crit Chance by 200 and DEF Penetration by 200.

artifacts.name: Solenis' Engraving
artifacts.description: Increases All DEF by {0}% and Max HP by {1}% for all allies every 10 sec. This effect can be stacked up to max 12 times and is irremovable. This effect does not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story: A covering with angel engraving that adroitly conceals the weapon of Solenis. The angel engraving is said to have been carved by masters with strong faith. However, after Solenis vanquished the Successor of Tuning who had led them, the symbol is regarded as cursed and thus a taboo among the descendants of the masters.

artifacts.name: Golem's Fuel
artifacts.description: Increases DMG dealt to Non-Hero enemies by {0}% and reduces DMG taken by {1}%. If target is [Holy Golem], the effect is multiplied by 3.
artifacts.story: A part of the holy golem's fuel. According to a research report of Magos Le'Flamme, it is bestowed with the same blessings of Lua as Solenis.

artifacts.name: Earth Storm
artifacts.description: When inflicted by CC, recovers Mana by {0} and gains [Earth Storm] for 10 sec, increasing All DMG nearby enemies take by {1}% every sec. If activated in the Arena, [Earth Storm] deals P.DMG equal to 3% of the target's Max HP to nearby enemies every sec. This effect will not inflict a Crit Hit. The effect of [Earth Storm] has a Cooldown of 20 sec.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of one of the 'faces' of the Mountain Fortress. This lively and flamboyant face feels sentimental and looks beautiful.

artifacts.name: Earth Protection
artifacts.description: At the beginning of battle, gain CC immunity and a 50% boost to P. and M. DEF stats for {0} sec.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of one of the 'faces' of the Mountain Fortress. A keen intellect can be felt from this taciturn face.

artifacts.name: Blessing of Earth
artifacts.description: When there is 1 enemy, ATK is boosted by {0}%.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of one of the 'faces' of the Mountain Fortress. The rage and bellicose nature of this angry face can be felt.

artifacts.name: Earth Core
artifacts.description: ATK, HP and all DEF are increased by {0}%.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of the core of the Mountain Fortress. As a source of infinite energy, it boosts the power of the owner.

artifacts.name: Earth Fortress
artifacts.description: When there is 1 enemy, reduces the target's Heal Rate by {0}% and increases own DMG dealt to Bosses by {1}%. This effect does not stack with effects from other allies.
artifacts.story: A miniaturized version of the 'shoulder' part of the Mountain Fortress. It is made by combining stone and wood using technomagic, harnessing natural yet artificial power of great strength.

artifacts.name: Nail Ornament of the Deep
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, fixes self's DEF to 0 and increases DMG dealt to bosses by {0}% for 200 sec. This effect is irremovable.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of the fingernail ornament that Protianus was wearing. A highly expensive magical artifact made from enchanted gold.

artifacts.name: Belt Ornament of the Deep
artifacts.description: At the beginning of the first battle, and every 30 sec, reduces DMG all allies take from enemies by {0}% for 3 sec. This effect is irremovable and does not stack with effects from other allies. Each time the effect expires, dispels negative effects from all allies.
artifacts.story: A miniaturized version of the waist ornament of Protianus. One can feel the strong yet silent energy of the flow that resembles the current of the deep sea.

artifacts.name: Trident of the Deep
artifacts.description: Dealing DMG to enemies 100 times increases ATK by {0}% and Crit Chance by {1} for 15 sec. This effect cannot be dispelled.
artifacts.story: A mystical weapon designed after the trident of Protianus. It bears the power of water like a tsunami.

artifacts.name: Ring of Spirit Morph
artifacts.description: At the beginning of every battle, HP does not fall below 10% for {0} sec. If HP falls below 15% for the duration of Skill, DMG dealt to Heroes will be reduced by 70% for 5 sec. All effects are irremovable.
artifacts.story: An ominous ring inhabited by evil spirits from your worst nightmare. When enchanted by this ring, you lose control over your body while your soul becomes trapped within an endless dream.

artifacts.name: Spellbound Ring of the Deep
artifacts.description: Upon the start of a battle for {0} sec, limit 1 enemy's ATK Spd to 1000 and reduce ATK by {1}%.
artifacts.story: A miniature version of the ring that Protianus was wearing. It is enchanted with a spell that curses and neutralizes foes.

artifacts.name: Guardian Crystal of the Deep
artifacts.description: When there is 1 enemy, all DEF is increased by {0}%.
artifacts.story: A blue gem that was once set on the crown of Protianus. A clear gem that represents protection.

artifacts.name: Abyssal Breath
artifacts.description: Increases DMG dealt to Non-Hero enemies of 2 allies with the highest ATK excluding self by {0}% and heals HP of all allies equal to 2.5% of Max HP every {1} sec. When there is 1 enemy, increases Heal Rate by x2. This effect does not stack with effects from other allies.
artifacts.story: Arm decoration of the Abyssal Goddess Xanadus. It resembles the face of a golden dragon and emits an enigmatic power.

artifacts.name: Abyssal Crown
artifacts.description: 30 sec after the battle starts, increases ATK of the ally with the highest ATK by {0}%. This effect cannot be dispelled, and it does not stack with other effects for allies.
artifacts.story: Hair accessory of Abyssal Goddess Xanadus. The serpent-shaped crown gives off a deadly scent.

artifacts.name: Abyssal Eye
artifacts.description: Upon taking damage, deals M.DMG of {0}% own ATK to the target and reduces ATK Spd of the target by {1} for 1.5 sec. After the ATK Spd Reduction Effect expires, the target is petrified for {2} sec. This effect will be activated only once every 30 sec.
artifacts.story: The Power source of Abyssal Goddess Xanadus. It looks like the its pupil moves, even though it's been severed from its body.

artifacts.name: Abyssal Nail Ornament
artifacts.description: Upon attack, deals P.DMG equal to {0}% of ATK that ignores DEF to the enemy every 0.5 sec for 10 sec. This effect will be activated once in 20 sec.
artifacts.story: Nail ornament of the Abyssal Goddess Xanadus. It is made from an alloy of unknown but special metals.

artifacts.name: Heart of the Abyss
artifacts.description: At the beginning of every battle, increases ATK of the ally with the highest ATK by {0}% and reduces ATK of the enemy with the highest ATK by 15% for 100 sec. The ATK Boost effect can be stacked up to max 5 times, and all effects are irremovable.
artifacts.story: The core of the power source that the Abyssal Goddess Xanadus summons. This mass of magical energy glows with a dazzling light, luring victims to their death.

artifacts.name: Infernal Bond
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, increases a random enemy's Cooldown of all Skills by {0} sec.
artifacts.story: A blazing bond of Velkazar, the Hellspawn Torturer. It's enchanted with Black Magic to control the overflowing power.

artifacts.name: Otherworldly Sword
artifacts.description: Consumes {0}% of self's current HP every sec and disables Lifesteal, but increases DMG dealt per sec by 0.5% and Crit DMG by 0.5%. DMG and Crit DMG Boost effect can be stacked up to max {1} times. This effect automatically deactivates when HP falls below 25%.
artifacts.story:
A fragment of darkness carried by Shakmeh.
It shifts its size depending on the user, making it available for petite people to use it with ease. The dark feelings of Shakmeh swirling inside the sword pains the body and spirit of anyone who wields it, but great power can be guaranteed to anyone who endures that pain.

artifacts.name: Infernal Greatsword
artifacts.description: Own heal rate decreases by 30%, while Penetration increases by {0} and Crit DMG increases by {1}%
artifacts.story: A blazing greatsword of Velkazar, the Hellspawn Torturer. Its flame seems powerful enough to engulf anything.

artifacts.name: Infernal Whip
artifacts.description: Every 8 sec, attacks all enemies and deals {0}% of ATK as M.DMG. Targets take {1}% increased DMG for the next 5 sec. DMG boost effect increases by {2}% with every activation, and can be stacked max 25 times. DMG boost effect cannot be used simultaneously with same effects of other allies.
artifacts.story: A blazing tail of Velkazar, the Hellspawn Torturer. It looks like a serpent shrouded in flame.

artifacts.name: Infernal Gate
artifacts.description: Increases All DEF by {0}%, DMG dealt to enemies by {1}%, and DMG dealt to Non-Hero enemies by {2}%.
artifacts.story: One of the blazing horns of Velkazar, the Hellspawn Torturer. It works as a channel to release the power of soul.

artifacts.name: Heart Cotton Candy
artifacts.description: When the battle starts, increases ATK of self and the ally with the highest ATK by {0}% for 20 sec. This effect will not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story:
Heart Cotton Candy, a must-have item for outings!
It melts in your mouth in no time!

artifacts.name: Cross Pumpkin Head
artifacts.description: Max HP is increased by {0}% and deal P.DMG worth 2% of Max HP to all nearby enemies within a small range.
artifacts.story: A mysterious object shaped like a sad pumpkin. It is said to make an eerie noise while hovering near the owner.

artifacts.name: Angry Pumpkin Head
artifacts.description: All DMG taken is reduced by {0}% and deal {1}% more DMG to enemies.
artifacts.story: A mysterious object shaped like a mad pumpkin. It huffs angrily while hovering near the owner.

artifacts.name: Happy Pumpkin Head
artifacts.description: Every 7 sec, increases Heal Rate by {0}% and heals HP by {1}% of own ATK. Heal rate increase can be stacked up to max 15 times and cannot be removed.
artifacts.story: A mysterious item shaped like a happy-looking pumpkin. It boosts the energy of the owner.

artifacts.name: Surprised Pumpkin Head
artifacts.description: When inflicted by CC, immediately recovers Mana by {0}% and increases ATK Spd by {1} for 5 sec. This effect activates once every 30 sec.
artifacts.story: A peculiar item shaped like a pumpkin with a surprised look. Its eerie ambiance startles those who look at it too.

artifacts.name: Pumpkin-Stuck Evil Spirit
artifacts.description: Increases own Max HP by {0}%. When there is 1 enemy, increases ATK of all allies by {1}%. This effect will not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story:
Lavril, who had decided to follow Lewisia, wandered around the shopping district of Orvel with Lewisia to enjoy the Halloween carnival event.

After all, to live among humans, one must take matters into their own hands and find a large crowd to blend in.
While Lavril was absent-mindedly watching the people enjoy the carnival, their gaze was caught upon a cute doll that resembled them on a selling stand.
Lavril stood still and looked at the doll for a long time. They were eventually swept by the crowd, and Lavril lost the sight of the doll. But Lewisia noticed Lavril's interest and managed to purchase it.

After buying the doll, Lewisia cast a protection spell on it, so that it will hide the presence of the holder to protect the Little Darkness from danger. She then gave the doll to Lavril.

artifacts.name: Frost Giant Mask
artifacts.description: ATK upon Frost Giants increases by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Frost Giants increases by {1} %.
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Frost Giant. The power of a snow mountain can be felt from it.

artifacts.name: Golden Mask of Ancient King
artifacts.description: Upon taking a hit, there is a 5% chance to gain invulnerability to all DMG for {0} sec. Has a cooldown of 5 sec.
artifacts.story: A golden mask once worn by God King of the desert. It is enchanted with the spell of absolute authority to protect its owner.

artifacts.name: Mask of Dark Elf
artifacts.description: ATK upon Dark Elves increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Dark Elves increases by {1} %
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Dark Elf. It gives off an aura of the soft moonlight.

artifacts.name: Mask of Draconic
artifacts.description: ATK upon Draconics increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Draconics increase by {1} %.
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Draconic. It resonates with the roar of smoldering evil.

artifacts.name: Mask of Goblin
artifacts.description: ATK upon Goblins increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Goblins increases by {1} %
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Goblin. It's actually kind of cute.

artifacts.name: Mask of Harpy
artifacts.description: ATK upon Harpies increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Harpies increases by {1} %
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Harpy. The sound of a brisk wind can be heard.

artifacts.name: Mask of Lizardman
artifacts.description: ATK upon Lizardmen increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Lizardmen increase by {1} %
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Lizardman. The aura of a sage can be felt from it.

artifacts.name: Mask of Orc
artifacts.description: ATK upon Orcs increase by {0} %, and DMG resistance against Orcs increases by {1} %
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of an Orc. It inspires a brutish desire for combat.

artifacts.name: Undead Mask
artifacts.description: Increases DMG to Undead by {0} % and Resistance against Undead by {1}%.
artifacts.story: A mask modeled after the face of a Skeleton. It smells like death.

artifacts.name: Assassin's Veil
artifacts.description: Increases P.Dodge by {0}. Each successful dodge increases ATK by {1}%, stacking up to max 20 times.
artifacts.story: A veil that may seem too eccentric and florid to be used by an assassin, but is, in fact, a magic tool that dulls the target's senses.

artifacts.name: Book of the Mad
artifacts.description: Reduces own Mana by {0} every sec, and increases own DMG dealt to enemies by {1}%.
artifacts.story: Book of a mad wizard who wandered about the wilderness. The cursed book created from human blood and skin. It consumes mana to grant berserk status to the owner without compromising their sanity. However, it continues to consume mana, ultimately bringing destruction to its owner as it depletes their mana.

artifacts.name: Burning Brazier of Elf
artifacts.description: Upon attacking an enemy, there is a {0}% chance to recover 1 MP.
artifacts.story: A mysterious brazier crafted by ancient Elves to honor the mother nature. It is the pinnacle of their magic, capable of producing an infinite amount of mana.

artifacts.name: Christmas Star Ornament
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, for 5 sec, increase Mana Recovery per sec by {0}%. Also, Crit Resistance is increased by {1}. This effect cannot be dispelled.
artifacts.story: A star ornament that blesses the sacred nights. It rises up to the sky and shines.

artifacts.name: Warm Turkey Dish
artifacts.description: Increases own Max HP by {0}% and All Block Chance by {1}.
artifacts.story: It is the must-try food for Thanksgiving. The freshly roasted turkey dish goes well with Hero's Inn special gravy sauce.

artifacts.name: Well-Done Turkey Roast
artifacts.description: Every 15 sec, recover HP equal to {0}% of Max HP for 3 sec.
artifacts.story: An exotic specialty that comes from a faraway land across the sea. It is said to be eaten during the celebration of harvest.

artifacts.name: Christmas Tree of Holy Night
artifacts.description: Increases Crit DMG by {0}%.
artifacts.story: A miniature of the legendary Christmas tree. It does not grant wishes anymore, but it still has the finest quality that makes the holy night beautiful.

artifacts.name: Cooling Delicacy in the Summer
artifacts.description: When the battle begins, reduces DMG from non-Hero enemies by {0}% for 30 second(s), and recovers {1} MP every 2 second(s).
artifacts.story:
This delicacy of Orvel is a must for anyone who can't stand the blazing summer heat.

One sip of it brings down the heat, another makes the heat go away.

artifacts.name: Crystal Music Box
artifacts.description: Increases DMG to Hero by {0} % and takes {1}% increased DMG.
artifacts.story: Crystal Music Box found in the ruins of Dukedom of Galluah. It has a beautiful yet sad melody.

artifacts.name: Dice of Magical Letters
artifacts.description: Normal attacks have a 3% chance to deal {0}% M.DMG.
artifacts.story: A die used in an ancient civilization for divination. Each face is engraved with mysterious illegible letters.

artifacts.name: Drinking Horn of Ancient Cow
artifacts.description: Normal attacks have a 10% chance to increase ATK by {0}% and ATK Spd by {1} for 10 sec.
artifacts.story: A glass made from the horn of a sacred bull that roams the sky. It is a magical drinking horn that embodies the essence of abundance.

artifacts.name: Fancy Traditional Pendant
artifacts.description: Crit Chance is increased by {0} and Crit DMG is increased by {1}%.
artifacts.story: A mystical charm said to get rid of bad luck and bring good luck. It's created by a famous foreign designer of magical goods.

artifacts.name: Fantastic Hybrid Animals
artifacts.description: When the battle starts, increases DMG to Non-Hero enemies by {0}% and takes {1}% reduced DMG for 200 sec.
artifacts.story: Encyclopedia for Hybrid Animals in Orvelia Continent. As a limited edition copy, it has a silhouette of Hybrid Animals embroidered with golden thread.

artifacts.name: Feather of Sacrifice
artifacts.description: For 120 sec after the battle starts, takes {0}% extra DMG and increases all DMG taken by the enemy boss by {1}%. This effect cannot be dispelled, and it does not stack with other effects for allies.
artifacts.story: A feather containing an alchemy equation of the exchange of equivalents. The equation will activate when the enemy's name is engraved on the user's body, weakening the enemy and its owner for a short period of time.

artifacts.name: Golden Apple of a Goddess
artifacts.description: When the hero's HP falls below 25%, recover {0}% of max HP and dispel all negative effects. Activates 1 time only.
artifacts.story: It's said to be one of the sacred artifacts bestowed by the goddess. A miraculous remedy said to heal any injury.

artifacts.name: Golden Cat Statue
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, increases ATK Spd by {0} for 15 sec.
artifacts.story: A curious golden statue in the shape of a golden cat, the symbol of good fortune. Sometimes it seems as if the cat is waving its paw.

artifacts.name: Insignia of Iron Conviction
artifacts.description: Every 50 times this character takes M.DMG, dispel all harmful effects and gain a shield worth {0}% of ATK for 5 sec. While this shield is in effect, gain immunity to CC and DMG Stacking effects.
artifacts.story: The crest used by the Guardian Knights of Orvelia prior to the Demon War. The stalwart resolve of the knights can be felt from it.

artifacts.name: Judgment of Light Bracelet
artifacts.description: ACC and CC ACC rise by {0}.
artifacts.story: A blessed bracelet once created by the Holy Knights of the Church of Lua. It's an antique magic tool, and only a few like this remain today.

artifacts.name: Kiddy Chick
artifacts.description: ATK Spd is increased by {0}
artifacts.story: A small chick figure toy that represents the innocence of children.

artifacts.name: Lion of Protection
artifacts.description: Increases own P.DEF by {0}%, and P.Block by {1}.
artifacts.story: Lion made from silver. It is the symbol of Orvel Royal family, and its eyes are made from blue sapphire. It is imbued with the longing to safeguard the kingdom, protecting the owner from evil.

artifacts.name: LuLu's Necklace
artifacts.description: When the battle starts, increases DMG to Non-Hero enemies by {0}% for 30 sec, and recovers Mana by {1} every 5 sec.
artifacts.story:
A brilliant necklace befitting Moon Rabbit LuLu.
It is made from the refined fragments of a full moon.
The magical power of the full moon seeps into the wearer's entire body the moment it is worn.

artifacts.name: Juno's Special Dessert
artifacts.description: Upon taking a hit, there is a 20% chance to increase All DMG the target takes by {0}% for 5 sec. This effect cannot be used with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story:
A dessert made by using the gelatin of a Slime.
Mixed with the juice of fruit, sugar, and other sweeteners, all it takes to finish it is to heat the mixture and cool it down.
Juno did not want the dessert to be named after her since it was made of monsters, but Yanne has secretly added Juno's name on the menu...

Beware- this dessert may turn back to a slime if left unattended.

artifacts.name: Juno's Special Vitality Stew
artifacts.description: Upon normal attack, deals P.DMG equal to {0}% of ATK over time for 5 sec. This effect cannot be used with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story:
A healthy stew made with the healthy ingredients all over from Orbis.
Having full of minerals and other nutrients, it is a powerful dish that can restore the vitality of anyone who eats it.
The price is not too expensive, which makes it available for everyone.
This is Juno's specialty dish full of love and her pride for the weary ones visiting the Hero's Inn.

artifacts.name: Madame's Bronze Mirrors
artifacts.description: Increases own M.Block Chance by {0} and M.DMG Reduction by {1}.
artifacts.story: A bronze mirror of an Ancient Technomagic Kingdom that a genius wizard gifted to his wife. It is inscribed with a rune for protecting a loved one.

artifacts.name: Magical Flute
artifacts.description: Every 8 sec, increases ATK Spd of 2 random allies and the caster by {0} for 4 sec.
artifacts.story: Ancient flute made from the bones of Orox, the guardian beast of snow mountains. It contains the charm of gales, which boosts the morale of warriors. Warriors may experience a slight increase in their speed when they hear its sound.

artifacts.name: New Year's Fireworks
artifacts.description: ATK is increased by {0}% for 60 sec at the start of each battle.
artifacts.story: An item to blow away the worries of 2017 for a fresh new start in 2018.

artifacts.name: New Year's Fanfare
artifacts.description: Increases ATK of 4 allies by {0}% for 20 sec at the beginning of every battle. This effect will not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story: This uplifting fanfare of trumpets spreads the blessing of the newly rising sun.

artifacts.name: New-Type Thruster
artifacts.description: When inflicted by CC, reduces self's Cooldown of all Skills by {0} sec and recovers {1} Mana every sec for 3 sec. Has a Cooldown of 20 sec.
artifacts.story:
The latest model of the thrusters that the Selva Company provided to the Empire. It's designed as the special Christmas Edition.
It looks like a regular sleigh, but it is capable of extreme speed.
If the durability issue is fixed, it could become a great invention.

artifacts.name: Orbs of Contract
artifacts.description: Every 7 sec, increase M.DEF by {0}% of ATK. This effect stacks up to 6 times.
artifacts.story: Orbs shared between two lovers. They represent the eternal companionship of two souls even when they are apart.

artifacts.name: Perfume of the Queen
artifacts.description: When inflicted by CC for 3 times, removes own Negative Effects, and increases ATK Spd by 500 and gains immunity to CC for {0} sec.
artifacts.story: Perfume used by legendary Golden Queen. It is the legendary perfume which can tempt anyone who smells the scent.

artifacts.name: Pocket Watch of Ancient Civilization
artifacts.description: Reduces Cooldown of self's all Skills by {0} sec every 10 sec and increases ATK Spd by {1} for 5 sec.
artifacts.story: A pocket watch that can fast-forward time slightly to provide a quick glimpse of one's destiny. Excessive use may prove to be quite dangerous.

artifacts.name: Primer for the Heroes
artifacts.description: When HP is 20% or below, increases ATK by {0}%, and increases ATK Spd and All DMG Reduction by {1}.
artifacts.story: This primer, which chronicles the stories of past heroes, is considered a bible for any new hero. It's written in ancient letters.

artifacts.name: Roaring Tiger Statue
artifacts.description: When Hero health falls below 35%, deal DMG equal to 100% of ATK to nearby enemies and knock them down. Targeted enemies lose {0}% ATK and {1} ATK Speed for 10 sec. Has a cooldown of 30 sec.
artifacts.story: An eerie gold statue designed after a roaring tiger. Under the right conditions, the tiger wakes up and makes everything around it tremble in fear.

artifacts.name: Sealed Chain of Ancient God
artifacts.description: Every {0} sec, cast Silence to a random enemy for {1} sec and remove positive effects.
artifacts.story: A chain said to be once used by the God King of the desert to fetter his slaves. Those who are restrained by this chain cannot resist at all.

artifacts.name: Solar Stone
artifacts.description: Deals P.DMG equal to {0}% of ATK to nearby enemies in a circular range of self every sec and reduces their Heal Rate by {1}% for 5 sec.
artifacts.story: A magic tool sculpted into the shape of the Sun. Made from a stone embodying the essence of fire, it has the power to cleanse and purify all evil energy surrounding its wearer.

artifacts.name: Sorcerous Black Dagger
artifacts.description: Upon auto-attacking, there is a {0}% chance to reduce the enemy's mana by {1}. Has a cooldown of 6 sec.
artifacts.story: An ancient sorcerous dagger thought to be used for assassinations. It is enchanted with a vile spell that disrupts mana.

artifacts.name: Soul Spring Water
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, heals {0}% HP and recovers {1}% Mana.
artifacts.story: One drop of it is said to become available every hundred years at the Soul Spring. A very rare and effective panacea.

artifacts.name: Talismans of Resistance
artifacts.description: Upon receiving a negative effect, removes all negative effects. Afterward, gains immunity to CC for {0} sec. Has a Cooldown of {1} sec.
artifacts.story: A pile of old exotic talismans that drives away harmful spirits. They are rendered useless for a while once used.

artifacts.name: Tarot Card of Loss
artifacts.description: Reduces Crit Chance by {0} and increases ATK by {1}%.
artifacts.story: A deck of Tarot Card containing unfathomable magic. Appears to be a lost property of someone. It is said to be crafted by Eucalytus the witch to honor the death of her loved one.

artifacts.name: The Ancient Scope
artifacts.description: When MP is at 100%, Crit Chance and ACC rise by {0} for 10 sec. Has a cooldown of 20 sec.
artifacts.story: A scope created by an ancient technomagi. A useful tool that can zoom into a faraway object to a good level of detail.

artifacts.name: Tome of Black Magic
artifacts.description: Every 10 sec, target a single enemy. Said enemy takes DMG that ignores DEF equal to {0}% of current HP each second for 5 sec, and reduces Mana by {1}. This skill is effective only in the Arena.
artifacts.story: A book with evil black magic. It is filled with many spells that the devil has taught to mankind.

artifacts.name: Vase of Sacrifice
artifacts.description: Upon taking DMG 50 times, heals HP of 1 random ally by {0}% of My ATK and increases the target's ATK by {1}% for 10 seconds.
artifacts.story: A vase dedicated to the tomb of a fallen general from the Demon War. Within it flows water from the river of Eden, glistening brilliantly.

artifacts.name: Fragment of an Ancient Kingdom
artifacts.description: Increases CC Resist by {0} and CC ACC by {1}.
artifacts.story: A component found from an ancient and mysterious machine. It is suspected to be a part of a teleportation device.

artifacts.name: Goddess of Glory
artifacts.description: Increases ATK Spd of 4 allies by {0} for 20 sec when the battle starts. This effect will not be stacked with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story: A golden statue of a goddess holding a laurel branch. It brings victory to its owner.

artifacts.name: Master Chef’s Recipe Book
artifacts.description: Increases self's All DEF by {0}%, and Heal Rate by {1}%.
artifacts.story:
They say there are those who go by the title, Master Chef.
It is a title given only to the best chefs who created a new paradigm in the history of cooking.
This rare book not only contains the best recipes in the world, but also contains information on how one can obtain the ingredients that are used in those recipes.

The book of course, also explains how challenging and dangerous it is to find those ingredients...

One interesting fact is that the signature dish of the first master chef who wrote this book is a sandwich.

artifacts.name: Pendulum of Fantasy
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, permanently increases ATK by {0}%. This effect stacks up to max 5 times, and is irremovable.
artifacts.story:
An artifact told to have been in Hexipolia's possession before he used the dice.
If you watch the pendulum move left and right, it feels as if the pendulum will suck you into a world of fantasy.

artifacts.name: Otherworldly Radiance
artifacts.description: At the beginning of the first battle, and every 15 sec, gains [Otherworldly Radiance] that lasts for 4 sec. If [Otherworldly Radiance] is still active after 4 sec, dispels negative effects from self and reduces All DMG taken by {0}% for 4 sec. If [Otherworldly Radiance] is dispelled in 4 sec, dispels positive effects from 2 random enemies, knocks them away for 3 sec, and reduces their Mana by {1}. DMG Reduction effect is irremovable.
artifacts.story:
A fragment of spite carried by Shakmeh.
It lends its power to those who pay the price with the fervor toward otherworldly darkness. The radiance of evil can overwhelm the enemy's appearance just with its aura, and paralyzes the user's logic, arousing them.
Whether this will result in a courageous warrior or blood-crazed madman is up to how they use it.

artifacts.name: Ancient God King's Coin
artifacts.description: Increases ATK and Crit DMG by {0}%.
artifacts.story:
During ancient times, God King Cain led the desert kingdom of Sekireinel to a golden age.
This is a commemorative coin crafted from the gold he extracted from the desert.
It holds mysterious power that makes one feel the sun's power and heat when held.

artifacts.name: Amethyst Pendulum
artifacts.description: Increases All Crit Resistance by {0} for 7 sec every 10 sec.
artifacts.story: An amethyst pendulum that has the power to drive away the dark energy, and detect negative energy.

artifacts.name: Otherworldly Helm
artifacts.description: Increases self's Max HP by {0}%, and upon taking DMG 3 times, reduces [DMG dealt to Heroes] of self and 2 enemies with the highest ATK by {1}% for 5 sec. This effect is irremovable and has a 30 sec Cooldown.
artifacts.story:
A fragment of hatred carried by Shakmeh.
This helm that takes the shape of a beast has a terrifying glare that makes anyone who looks into its eyes feel the terror of being prey. The terror that takes away the will to fight is deeply engraved within the helm, affecting the user as well.

artifacts.name: Treasure Hunt Capsule
artifacts.description: At the beginning of each battle, immediately reduces Cooldown of self's all Skills by {0} sec and increases DMG dealt to non-Hero enemies by {1}%. The DMG Boost against Non-Hero enemies can be stacked up to max 10 times and is irremovable. At 10 stacks, the Cooldown Reduction effect is doubled.
artifacts.story:
A capsule used in the treasure hunt event hosted at the Orvel Water Park. It is designed to be sealed so that it can float on water, and anyone who gets their hand on it can close or open it. However, since the inside of the capsule is specially designed to melt upon contacting water, it should be opened outside water.
Each capsule contains a note, and most of the notes, of course, are losing tickets. The notes vary starting from 5th place to 1st place, and it is said that the one who finds the note that places them in the 1st place will receive a great reward.

artifacts.name: Forge Hammer MK-II
artifacts.description: Normal attacks have a 5% chance to increase ATK Spd by {0} for 5 sec.
artifacts.story:
A replica of the Hammer of Titan, Jin’s favorite tool.
Its durability is on par with the Hammer of Titan which only 3 of its kind still remain.
It is too heavy for humans to wield since it was miniaturized in Dragon standard.

artifacts.name: Honorary Trophy
artifacts.description: Increases ATK by {0}% and Crit Chance by {1}.
artifacts.story: An honorary trophy that is given to a Hero who trained hard.

artifacts.name: Honorary Medal
artifacts.description: Increases ATK, HP, and All DEF of all allies by {0}%. This effect does not stack with same effects from other allies.
artifacts.story: An honorary medal that is given to a Hero who put in a lot of effort.

artifacts.name: Hero's Plaque of Appreciation
artifacts.description: Increases Max HP by {0}%. 30 sec after the battle starts, increases Crit DMG of the ally with the highest ATK excluding self by {1}%. This effect is irremovable and does not stack with same effects from other allies.
artifacts.story: An honorary plaque that is given to a Hero who fought hard.

artifacts.name: Academic Achievement Award
artifacts.description: Increases ATK of all allies by {0}%, and All DEF of self by {1}%. This effect will not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story:
In recognition of your outstanding excellence, superior performance, and good conduct, we hereby confer this medal to you. 
- Principal Rephy

artifacts.name: Dragon's Doomstone
artifacts.description: Increases DMG dealt to Non-Hero enemies by {0}% and takes {1}% reduced DMG from them. If the target is a [Dragon], the effect is tripled.
artifacts.story: A gem that holds the wrath of the descendants of Apocalypsion. It is said that this gem contains their wrath against the matriarch who neglected them.

artifacts.name: Apocalypsion's Tear
artifacts.description: When there is only 1 enemy or more than 5 enemies, increases ATK and Crit DMG of all allies by {0}% and {1}% respectively. This effect does not stack with other similar effects cast by allies.
artifacts.story: The jewel inserted on Apocalypsion's forehead. It is the tear that Apocalypsion shed as she lost many of her descendants in the past. She shed a tear only once, and ever since that tear became a jewel on her forehead, she never shed a tear in front of anyone. It is also known as the White Teardrop.

Apocalypsion.name: Apocalypsion
Apocalypsion.title: Calamity of Destruction
Apocalypsion.characteristics: Since Apocalypsion's [Invitation to the Abyss] deals massive DMG to targets inflicted with [Abyssal Curse], you need to dispel [Abyssal Curse]. Also, when Apocalypsion takes a fatal DMG, [Power of Hatred] is activated and she summons meteors to annihilate all her enemies. Use CC Skills to reduce [Power of Hatred] and stop Apocalypsion's Skill. All attacks from Apocalypsion have high Crit Chance, so watch out!

Ascalon.name: Ascalon
Ascalon.title: Sentry of the Sanctuary
Ascalon.characteristics:
Ascalon constantly reduces Heroes' Mana. so keep a close eye on your Mana when you're facing Ascalon.
If you get hit by Ascalon, your Mana Recovery will be reduced. And if your Mana reaches 0, your Skills will be sealed, so watch out!

Delta.name: Delta
Delta.title: Predator MK-XX
Delta.characteristics:
Since ARCDIM X Delta continuously stacks Bleed, you need to use Skills that dispel negative effects. Also, because it greatly increases P.Dodge until it takes a certain number of hits in a specific pattern, you need to use effects related to ACC.
Also, be aware that ARCDIM X Delta has high Crit Resistance.

Devourer Shakmeh.name: Devourer Shakmeh
Devourer Shakmeh.title: Devourer
Devourer Shakmeh.characteristics: Devourer Shakmeh dungeon is consisted of 5 Waves. The Sekireinel Totem that appears in each Wave reduces the Heal Rate every set amount of time. From Stage 5 battles or above, it dispels positive effects from the enemy with the highest ATK, so be careful. Shakmeh becomes stronger if he has more Mana, and all of his attacks ignore the enemy's DEF. Use Heroes that reduce the enemy's Mana and Heroes that reduce the enemy's ATK to defeat him.

Event Protianus.name: Event Protianus
Event Protianus.title: The Unstoppable Lonely King
Event Protianus.characteristics: The Unstoppable Lonely King receives only 1 DMG from all attacks. His attacks deal DMG proportional to enemy Max HP.

Galgoria.name: Galgoria
Galgoria.title: Grasp of Death
Galgoria.characteristics:
Galgoria constantly recovers its HP. Reduce its Heal Rate or attack it with massive DMG to defeat it.
If you deal DMG to Galgoria several times, the ally that dealt the highest DMG will be sealed for a certain period, so be careful!

Gushak.name: Gushak
Gushak.title: Chieftan of the Blood Altar
Gushak.characteristics: Stacks [Orc Rage] each time the boss takes DMG. Stacks up to 100 times, which causes Enragement, greatly increasing stats. Heroes that can [Dispel] advantageous states are advantageous in this stage.

Imet.name: Imet
Imet.title: Courage of the Desert
Imet.characteristics: Imet will use [Swift Execution] after imprisoning all its enemies in Sand Prison. You must protect your Hero with the lowest P.DEF from dying. Be careful when Imet successfully blocks an attack while Desert Guardian's Bladecraft is active, as it will continuously increase its ATK.

Lakreil.name: Lakreil
Lakreil.title: Stakes of Wrath
Lakreil.characteristics: [Deadly Boomerang] cast after [Body Crash] leaves permanent scars on enemies. As Lakreil will stop casting deadly boomerang once [Rage of Lakreil] expires, you should dodge his attacks or deal massive P.DMG to Lakreil.

Manticore.name: Manticore
Manticore.title: Beast of Chaos
Manticore.characteristics: [Manticore Venom] deals large DMG to frontal enemies and summons scorpions. If the frontal hero cannot keep up with the DMG, the formation will fall. [Rush of Death] deals massive P.DMG to all heroes and requires [CC] to be stopped.

Maviel.name: Maviel
Maviel.title: Berserker Assassin
Maviel.characteristics: [Shadow Stealth] is a special state that dodges all attacks up to 100 times, after which the skill is dispelled for a set amount of time. Heroes with high hit-rate and Atk. Spd are advantageous in this stage.

Mountain Fortress.name: Mountain Fortress
Mountain Fortress.title: Legacy of the Ancient Technomagic Kingdom
Mountain Fortress.characteristics: The Mountain Fortress loses DEF and takes increased M.DMG while its Core is vulnerable. When it uses [Defensive Mode], use M.DMG to strip out the Core, creating an opportunity to deal massive DMG.

Musama.name: Musama
Musama.title: Eye of the Sun
Musama.characteristics: Relic of the Sky creates a Healing Field which nullifies any DMG the Relic may take, constantly dispels negative effects, and disrupts ranged Heroes from healing their HP. All these effects become deactivated when Musama casts [Icon of the Sun]. Try to destroy the Relic of the Sky during that opening.

Nordik.name: Nordik
Nordik.title: Ancient Lich
Nordik.characteristics: Upon taking M. DMG, reflects M.DMG and silences the aggressor. Physical heroes and CC Resistance stats are advantageous in this stage.

Nubis.name: Nubis
Nubis.title: Queen of Shackles
Nubis.characteristics: [Children of the Queen] increases the ATK and DEF of the boss greatly per each minion summoned. Magic heroes with AOE spells are advantageous in this stage.

Otherworldly Shakmeh.name: Otherworldly Darkness Shakmeh
Otherworldly Shakmeh.title: Otherworldly Darkness
Otherworldly Shakmeh.characteristics: You will battle Otherworldly Darkness Shakmeh with 2 parties, and you must be careful since the two parties will not affect each other. Also, Shakmeh will be equipped with new Skills for battles above Stage 3 and Stage 5, so you need to be prepared. You can use [Protection of the Oasis] and [Wrath of the Desert] Skills when you are battling Otherworldly Darkness Shakmeh. Use them to defeat Shakmeh.

Protianus.name: Protianus
Protianus.title: Ruler of the Sunken Kingdom
Protianus.characteristics: You must rescue allies caught by Protianus's [Water Prison] effectively by dealing P.DMG to the Boss. Without dispelling [Water Prison], the party will lose much of their Damage Dealing capacity.

Sekmaha.name: Sekmaha
Sekmaha.title: Envoy of the Flow
Sekmaha.characteristics: If Sekmaha's Skill is used during an advantageous flow, it becomes stronger. If used during an unfavorable flow, it becomes weaker. You should utilize the CC gauge to your advantage to control the flow. Also, since positive effects of [Waterfall] and [Sea] are enhanced depending on the current amount of Mana of your Heroes, you should try to keep Mana high.

Siegfried.name: Siegfried
Siegfried.title: Distorted Dawn
Siegfried.characteristics:
Siegfried can revive 2 times if he is near death. Each time he overcomes death, the power of his sword becomes stronger. In his final state, the aura of his sword will become incredibly big and start preying upon the Heroes in the backline. Make sure to protect your Heroes located in the back.
Siegfried becomes incredibly powerful when his Mana is full, so prevent him from recovering Mana to the max.

Solenis.name: Solenis
Solenis.title: Holy Guardian of Goddess
Solenis.characteristics: Solenis has Mana and [Engineered Power] that have to be reduced by using skills with Mana Reduction, Freeze, and Petrification. It also uses [Endless Retribution] to randomly inflict a certain CC. Quickly dispel CC by meeting the dispelling condition. If you don't, you will take continuous DMG.

Tersio.name: Tersio
Tersio.title: Deranged Dragon
Tersio.characteristics: As [Deathly Dragon] state increases Tersio's DMG dealt to enemies and his Crit Chance, you must dispel it. [Death's Door] constantly deals massive M.DMG and increases M.DMG the target takes. Since it becomes irremovable upon reaching the max number of stacks, it must be dispelled regularly. Also, when Tersio takes a certain amount of DMG, [Power of Hatred] is activated and he soars to the sky after a while to annihilate all enemies. Use CC Skills to reduce [Power of Hatred] and stop Tersio from using the Skill.

Tyrfas.name: Tyrfas
Tyrfas.title: Divine Beast of Absolute Zero
Tyrfas.characteristics: When Tyrfas uses [Avalanche], quickly deal M.DMG to cancel its skill activation. Watch out for the Chill effect, it will prevent you from HP recovery.

Velkazar.name: Velkazar
Velkazar.title: Hellspawn Torturer
Velkazar.characteristics: Enemies hit by the [Scorching Heat] is knocked back into the [Zone of Inferno]. [Zone of Inferno] deals great DMG and weakens your DEF, so fast escape is crucial. When [Executioner's Casket] is summoned, focus fire to destroy the casket, which will deal great DMG to Velkazar, and will cancel out [Hellfire].

Xakios.name: Xakios
Xakios.title: Cursed Root of the World Tree
Xakios.characteristics: [Strike of the Giant Beast] deals massive DMG to knocked over enemies. Clear the knocked over state of [Giant Earthquake] or use heroes with [CC Resistance] skills are advantageous in this stage.

Xanadus.name: Xanadus
Xanadus.title: Abyssal Goddess
Xanadus.characteristics: She was once a goddess of the Underworld that was forgotten by history. Empowered with the Abyssal Darkness, the ancient being has become a World Boss.

Zeta.name: Zeta
Zeta.title: Predator MK-XX
Zeta.characteristics:
Since ARCDIM X Zeta deals massive M.DMG that permanently reduces Heroes' Heal Rate until it takes a certain number of hits in a specific pattern, you need to use Heroes that can deliver multiple hits and increase Heal Rate.
Also, be aware that ARCDIM X Zeta has high Crit Resistance.
